jobs.title: Creator Acquisition & Content Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Your mission TikTok Shop verändert die Art und Weise, wie Menschen Produkte entdecken und kaufen – und wir gestalten diese Entwicklung aktiv mit. GENUINE gehört zu den führenden TikTok-Shop-Agenturen Deutschlands. Wir unterstützen Marken dabei, durch Creator-getriebenen E-Commerce, kreativen Content und datenbasierte Strategien nachhaltig zu wachsen. Für unser wachsendes CAP Team (Creator Acquisition & Production) suchen wir einen kreativen, kommunikationsstarken und TikTok-begeisterten Creator Acquisition & Content Manager (m/w/d) . Du verbringst gerne Zeit auf TikTok, erkennst Trends, bevor sie viral gehen, und weißt, was guten Content ausmacht? Du liebst es, mit Menschen zusammenzuarbeiten, kreative Ideen zu entwickeln und Videos zu produzieren? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Deine Aufgaben Creator Recruiting & Community Building Du identifizierst, kontaktierst und gewinnst neue TikTok Creator für unser wachsendes Creator-Netzwerk. Du baust langfristige Beziehungen zu Creatorn und Influencern auf und pflegst diese aktiv. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team eine lebendige und engagierte Creator Community rund um GENUINE und unsere Partnermarken. Du organisierst Creator Meetups, Networking-Events, Content Days und weitere Community-Aktivitäten. Du bist eine zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Creator und unterstützt sie bei ihrer Weiterentwicklung. TikTok Trends & Content Strategie Du beobachtest aktuelle TikTok-Trends, virale Challenges, neue Creator und innovative Content-Formate. Du recherchierst und analysierst erfolgreiche TikTok-Videos und identifizierst die Faktoren, die sie besonders erfolgreich machen. Du erkennst virale Hooks, Storytelling-Techniken und kreative Ansätze, die Reichweite, Engagement und Conversions steigern. Du entwickelst aus Trends und Performance-Daten kreative Content-Ideen, Konzepte und überzeugende Videoskripte. Du konzipierst innovative Content-Formate, die auf unterschiedliche Marken, Produkte und Zielgruppen zugeschnitten sin

jobs.title: Video Content Creator
jobs.description: LOWONGAN KERJA CONTENT CREATOR WDCOMPUTER.ID | Toko Laptop Second Kualifikasi Pria, kreatif, inovatif, dan memiliki ide konten yang menarik. Memahami tren media sosial, khususnya TikTok, Instagram Reels, dan Facebook. Mampu membuat konten foto dan video untuk kebutuhan promosi produk. Mampu mengoperasikan aplikasi editing video seperti CapCut atau aplikasi sejenis. Percaya diri di depan kamera dan memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik. Memahami dasar copywriting, storytelling, dan teknik pemasaran digital. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Disiplin, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu bekerja sesuai target. Memiliki ketertarikan terhadap dunia laptop dan teknologi menjadi nilai plus. Memiliki portofolio konten menjadi nilai tambah. Tanggung Jawab Membuat ide, konsep, dan perencanaan konten kreatif untuk promosi toko. Memproduksi dan mengedit video konten produk laptop second untuk TikTok, Instagram, dan platform lainnya. Membuat konten review, unboxing, edukasi spesifikasi laptop, perbandingan produk, dan promo penjualan. Menampilkan keunggulan produk, spesifikasi, kondisi unit, serta harga dengan cara yang menarik dan mudah dipahami. Melakukan pengambilan foto dan video produk untuk kebutuhan pemasaran. Mengikuti tren media sosial dan mengembangkan ide konten yang relevan dengan target pasar. Membantu meningkatkan engagement, jangkauan akun, dan penjualan melalui konten digital. Menyusun jadwal upload serta memastikan konten dipublikasikan secara konsisten. Mengevaluasi performa konten dan membuat ide perbaikan berdasarkan hasilnya. Berkoordinasi dengan tim sales dan admin untuk mendapatkan informasi stok, harga, serta promo terbaru.

jobs.title: Content & Community Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Deine Rolle Wir sind HeyHoney, ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit einer treuen Community und einem klaren Produkt. Diese Community ist eines unserer wertvollsten Assets – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Bei uns erwarten dich Verantwortung, Geschwindigkeit, Flexibilität und viel kreativer Gestaltungsraum – verbunden mit der Möglichkeit und Erwartung, diesen aktiv zu nutzen. Während unser Head of Performance & Growth die Skalierung verantwortet, machst du unsere Marke jeden Tag erlebbar: Du entwickelst unsere organischen Kanäle, unseren Content und unsere Community-Formate weiter – vom ersten Konzept bis zum fertigen Reel, vom Community-Kommentar bis zum Event. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Creator, UGC-Creator und Freelancer zusammen und berichtest direkt an unsere Head of Performance & Growth. Dein Verantwortungsbereich Content & Social Media: Du betreust und entwickelst unsere organischen Kanäle – insbesondere Instagram, TikTok und Pinterest – und hast Trends, Plattform-Logiken und neue Formate immer im Blick. Content-Produktion: Du entwickelst Content-Ideen und setzt sie hands-on um – insbesondere Short-Form-Video. Dabei kannst du sowohl neuen Content produzieren als auch vorhandenes Material kreativ weiterdenken und daraus neue, plattformgerechte Inhalte entwickeln. Für Produktionen arbeitest du bei Bedarf mit UGC-Creator und Freelancer zusammen und steuerst diese eigenständig. Creator & UGC: Du identifizierst relevante Creator, baust Beziehungen auf und entwickelst ein nachhaltiges Netzwerk aus UGC-Creator, Freelancer und Partner, das unsere Marke langfristig voranbringt. Community Management: Du bist eine der Stimmen von HeyHoney. Du interagierst regelmäßig mit unserer Community, aktivierst sie und entwickelst Ideen, mit denen aus Kund echte Fans werden. Dabei entwickelst du Community-Formate, die Bindung und Retention stärken. Community Events: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Ideen für Community Events und begleitest deren Umsetzung – von Planung und Partne

jobs.title: Conceptual Copywriter

In this role, you’ll partner with designers, strategists, and performance teams to develop concept-driven copy that delivers both creative impact and measurable results. You will work closely with enterprise-level customers helping translate complex technical ideas into clear, compelling messaging for global audiences. This role is ideal for a writer who enjoys turning strategic insights into powerful creative ideas while crafting high-performing copy across digital platforms. What You'll Do Develop concept-driven copy and campaign ideas across digital advertising, landing pages, email, and social channels. Translate complex technical concepts into clear, engaging messaging for enterprise audiences. Write both short-form and long-form copy tailored to different stages of the marketing funnel. Collaborate closely with designers, UX specialists, and performance marketing teams to bring creative ideas to life. Support the development of messaging frameworks for campaigns, product launches, and marketing initiatives. Contribute to creative presentations and help shape 360° campaign concepts. Iterate on copy through experimentation, A/B testing, and performance insights. Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high creative standards. What You'll Need To Succeed 4+ years of experience in a creative agency or fast-paced marketing environment. Strong conceptual copywriting portfolio demonstrating campaign thinking and digital execution. Experience writing for technical or complex products. Ability to simplify complex ideas into clear, persuasive messaging. Experience writing for performance channels such as paid social, email campaigns, and landing pages. jobs.title: Senior Documentation Specialist
jobs.description: About this position As the Senior Documentation Specialist, you ensure the effective management, quality, completeness, and inspection readiness of essential clinical trial documentation for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities, including the sponsor TMF and oversight of CRO and laboratory TMFs. You acts as an experienced TMF specialist, working closely with Clinical Operations and cross-functional study teams to provide expert guidance on document processes, compliance, risk management and continuous improvement. Your tasks: Oversee documentation handling, filing and archival activities for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities across relevant functional areas, ensuring that final documents are complete, accurate, traceable and maintained in the company document management system. Perform complex quality-control reviews and provide technical oversight of QC activities completed by TMF colleagues and external partners, in accordance with applicable SOPs, the CDISC TMF Reference Model, study-specific TMF Plans and regulatory requirements. Plan and conduct risk-based periodic oversight reviews of CRO and laboratory TMFs; identify quality or completeness issues, recommend remediation actions, monitor progress and escalate significant or recurring risks. Lead TMF inspection-readiness activities for assigned studies and coordinate documentation support during audits and regulatory inspections; develop and coordinate documentation-related corrective and preventive actions, monitor implementation and verify effective closure. Act as a TMF subject matter expert for study teams and external partners, providing practical guidance and escalating matters that require management direction or cross-functional decisions. Analyse and communicate TMF quality and performance metrics, identify trends and recommend improvements to processes, systems, templates and ways of working. Ensure assigned activities comply with company and CRO SOPs, ICH GC

jobs.title: Freelance Writer
jobs.description: Our organization is seeking content writers to create articles and blog posts on a variety of topics. The rate of pay is $20 per 100 words (this comes out to approximately $100 per article or $50 per hour). Some topics you may be asked to write about include the following (you can always turn down a topic if you do not feel comfortable writing about it, however if you have experience or expertise in a specific area, please let us know): Health & beauty Fitness Home Decor Fashion Sports Do it yourself Finance Legal Medical Family/Parenting Relationships Real Estate Restaurants Contracting (plumbing, pool building, remodeling, etc.) These are just some of the more general industries and topics that we cover. Requirements : We ask that all work be completed using a word processor such as Microsoft Word or Open Office A reliable internet connection and the ability to meet deadlines Good communication skills and respond in a timely manner to editorial staff when they ask for updates on tasks, etc Work well as a team member with the rest of our content management and editorial staff Note : Applicants to this job signaled that accessing some writing tasks may require payment.

jobs.title: Content Reviewer - United States
jobs.description: We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit. A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform. By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself. Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies. Service Rates The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Qualification path Qualification Process No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process
